status: Cabin designer for the existing Studio. Messaging, calls and shared media remain local demonstrations.

cabin.type: Generated original unbranded cabin concept; not a manufacturer photograph
cabin.sourceReference: Prior continuous cabin concept used for framing and broad digital dashboard proportions; hardware redesigned following the user request
changes: Original unbranded four-spoke wheel and blank matte hub
New rounded-rectangle vents, overhead controls, and door hardware
Preserved low broad windshield, upper typing strip, and continuous passenger door geometry
Cyan accent line matched to Asgard #5FD8FF
Fixed mirror removed; runtime folding self-view and passenger side-view self camera
cabin.runtimeEncoding: JPEG quality80; no creative image changes after generation

road.creator: Anna Mitsu
road.playback: Original forward motion, normal repeat cut
road.content: Same approved source and first six seconds; no replacement footage

preview.calls: Local device/layout previews only; no recipient contacted
preview.sharing: Incoming sample or selected local media activates the passenger-window view; no upload or recipient delivery. Side-view mirror uses the same optional local camera stream.
preview.messaging: Local sample thread; no server message writes

camera.technique: Perspective rotation of rays over a continuous photographic cabin environment
camera.model: A source photograph with a calibrated virtual pinhole camera; not a fully modeled 3D vehicle
camera.road: Source-space windshield mask and video composited before perspective projection
camera.sharedMedia: DOM homographies use the same projector as the photographic environment
camera.verification: Analytic projection, offline pixel diagnostics, and explicit media/DOM/WebGL stubs; no browser or physical-device verification
